articles.title: Premium spice markets remain buoyant as Cardamom prices stay firm - AgroSpectrum India
articles.description: Kumily auctions record high-value trades while eastern India’s large cardamom markets sustain stable pricing

articles.title: Cardamom exports lose aroma as prices surge - BusinessLine
articles.description: Cardamom exports decline as prices rise, prompting cautious purchasing strategies among importers amid uncertain crop prospects due to monsoon conditions.

articles.title: New cardamom crop fetches Rs. 95,000 per 40 kg - The Rising Nepal
articles.description: The new crop of large cardamom has started fetching Rs. 95,000 per man (40 kg) in Taplejung. The new crop, which began arriving in the market two to three days ago, is being traded at the rate of Rs. 95,000 per man.

articles.title: Wild elephant attack in Keralam’s Idukki kills cardamom plantation worker - The Hindu
articles.description: A cardamom plantation worker in Idukki was killed in a wild elephant attack, highlighting rising human-elephant conflicts in Kerala.
